snapshot.subject: Re: RFQ – Can Body Necking / Flanging / Beading Machine – Ø73 mm and Ø99 mm
snapshot.body: Supplier states maximum speed is 500 CPM and stable speed is 400 CPM. D73 is described as a four-station Necking, Flanging, Beading and Seaming line. D99 is described as a single Necking machine plus a three-station Flanging, Beading and Seaming line.

proposal.company_name: Zhejiang Golden Eagle Food Machinery Co., Ltd.
proposal.need_hypothesis: Golden Eagle has supplied two configurations that require technical and commercial qualification against the buyer's actual throughput and integration requirements.
proposal.evidence_statement: Supplier states max 500 CPM, stable 400 CPM, describes separate D73/D99 configurations and attached two quotation PDFs.
unknowns: guaranteed continuous speed under actual can specifications
impact of 400 CPM stable speed on 600/650 CPM rated lines
